summary: H World Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its 2026 annual general meeting, which is a routine corporate governance matter. The resolutions passed included the ratification of Deloitte as auditor, re-election of directors, and authorization for officers to implement the resolutions. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other event-driven transaction is present. The filing is a standard disclosure of ordinary meeting outcomes with no deal terms or structural changes.
